118487980.notes: Photo 2024-05-30 Školská 220/1: cream single full masonry wall storey with dark pitched roof and two prominent roof-integrated arched front gables; usable attic is the second mapped OSM level, NOT a second full-height facade. Indicative eave-wall height 3.75 m is modelled from photograph, NOT surveyed. Actual roof geometry and opening coordinates require multi-view validation. Main roof uses a bounded hip approximation under two original cross-gable bays; the roof is deliberately not an unsupported four-corner gable.
